description: 两片必须实现同一文件协议；这是接口约定，不表示运行器已经实现。
encoding: UTF-8; JSONL one object per line; timestamps UTC ISO8601; SHA256 lowercase hex of exact file bytes; paths absolute
publication: Mutable JSON snapshots and immutable final files are published by same-filesystem temporary file plus atomic rename. Immutable files must never be replaced with different content. All readers verify hashes and version before using READY.
protocol_copy: COORD/protocol.json is an exact-byte copy of this file, published under COORD/protocol.lock; lock acquisition timeout 90 seconds.

runtime_status.progress_definition: Actual stage/event advancement, accepted result, or queue transition; a periodic heartbeat must not update last_progress_at by itself.

initial_results.coverage: Every task in the shard exactly once, all first results valid and immutable; no pending or blocked initial job. Imported first results retain their original label and lineage.

initial_ready.validation: Reader rechecks full assignment coverage and referenced first-result hashes before sampling; READY presence alone is insufficient.

sample.ready_hash_maps: initial_ready_sha256 and initial_results_sha256 are objects with keys A and B
sample.method: One random.Random(2026110401); iterate sorted scenarios containing initial pass; each population sorted by task_id; rng.sample(pop, ceil(len(pop)*0.05)); sort chosen rows by task_id; append in scenario order. No reseeding between scenarios or shards.
sample.content_hash: Consumers compute SHA256 of the published file and bind it in SHARD_READY; do not embed a self-referential hash.
sample.queue_ownership: Each controller validates the whole sample but creates pass_audit jobs only in its own queue for selected task_ids it owns.

global_control.transaction: Under global_control.lock, validate/recover append log, deduplicate event_id, assign increasing seq, append and flush event, then atomically replace derived snapshot. A crash between event and snapshot is recovered by replay. Preserve any incomplete trailing bytes as crash evidence before repair; never silently discard complete records.
global_control.counter: In lock-defined event order, infrastructure_success resets streak; classified infrastructure_failure increments it; other events do not alter streak. At streak >=3 stop_dispatch stays true until a resume_verified event supported by remediation evidence. fatal_global sets stop_dispatch true immediately. Ordinary later successes cannot clear an existing stop.
global_control.scope: Use global, shard:A, shard:B, or an explicit task_id list; ordinary isolated citation/business errors must not emit infrastructure_failure.
global_control.dispatch_check: Check global snapshot before every new model dispatch. Short in-flight calls finish within their deadlines. Controller restart must not clear a stop. An unreadable or incompatible control state requires pausing new dispatch, not assuming permission.
global_control.initialization: Before first dispatch, acquire global_control.lock. Only if both event log and snapshot are absent in a new run, initialize seq=0, streak=0, stop_dispatch=false. If events exist, derive snapshot by validated replay; never reset an existing run merely because a snapshot is missing.

shard_ready.precondition: All own tasks completed; required reviews/samples/corrections complete; unresolved_corrections empty; program checks and master semantic acceptance approved.

merge.ownership: Either controller may merge under lock after verifying both SHARD_READY files and all referenced hashes. Neither writes the other queue. Existing matching merged results are reused.
merge.completion: 5909 unique original task_ids exactly covered; 8 regression cases excluded from task count; all required checks and correction scopes resolved.
